posts.content_md:
Go to Michael's (craft store, not Plano, Tx!) and buy some sheets of black 'Stick-it-Felt'. This is stiffened adhesive backed felt. You'll use it everywhere you need to kill a reflection from a mount, etc.

I also use it for hiding ugly magnetic mounts for the subject - see 

[http://holographyforumorg.ntitemp.com/p ... php?t=3665](http://holographyforumorg.ntitemp.com/phpBB2/viewtopic.php?t=3665)
